title: Sign device chain entries
responsibility: Write canonical JSON, sign and verify device chain entries with ECDSA P-256, and hash them for the next entry.

inputs.name: sealedCanonical.value
inputs.description: JSON value to serialize with consistently ordered object keys.

inputs.name: chainEntryBytes.entry
inputs.description: Unsigned device chain entry to serialize for signing.

inputs.name: sealedChainEntry.signer
inputs.description: Device signing key and signer identity for the new entry.

inputs.name: sealedChainEntry.entry
inputs.description: Unsigned chain entry whose signer and signature will be attached.

inputs.name: verifyChainEntry.signingPublic
inputs.description: Base64url-encoded P-256 public signing key expected for the signer.

outputs.name: sealedCanonical
outputs.description: Canonical JSON string for the supplied value.

outputs.name: chainEntryBytes
outputs.description: UTF-8 bytes used as the signature input.

outputs.name: sealedChainEntry
outputs.description: Chain entry with signer identity and signature attached.

outputs.name: verifyChainEntry
outputs.description: Whether the supplied public key verifies the entry signature.

outputs.name: chainEntryHash
outputs.description: Hex digest referenced by the next chain entry.
